scope: Exact independently reviewed DMG crop replacements, applied after old-metadata and image SHA checks. Source-edge limitations remain explicit.

records.reviewBasis: Visually inspected old/new contact and checked replacement SHA; DMG p.11 crop reaches original PDF page edge, so unavailable glyphs remain a source limitation.
records.observation: The target methods now have headings and full available paragraph width; some text reaches the supplied PDF page-image edge, so any glyphs absent from that source cannot be recovered by recropping.
records.focusNote: Full-crop sentinel retained; the independent review confirms crop coverage, not precise highlight geometry.
